facts.business: TARC Limited develops luxury residential projects on fully owned, historically acquired land parcels in Delhi and Gurugram, focusing on ultra-luxury developments such as TARC Tripundra, TARC Kailasa, and TARC Ishva.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Title deeds of immovable properties (other than leasehold) are held in the company's name except as noted; loans/advances to subsidiaries and firms with corporate guarantees disclosed.

key_risks: Execution risk in large-scale project delivery
Related party transactions with subsidiaries and firms
facts.related_party_note: The Company has provided loans/advances to subsidiaries, step-down subsidiaries, partnership firms, and LLPs, with corporate guarantees. Outstanding balances as at March 31, 2026: Subsidiaries/Step-down Subsidiaries - Loans Rs 24,924.52 lakh, Corporate Guarantees Rs 1,67,600.00 lakh; Firm/LLP - Loans Rs 38.03 lakh.
